g.text: Noise replaces 6/30 input neurons at every phoneme. Shading: mean of 10 independent noisy prefix probes; no smoothing.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #253847

g.text: The clean band is created by ordering; its persistence in independent corrupted inputs—not its shape—is the evidence.
